# Spec Kit Developer Guide

> A friendly, hands-on guide to Spec-Driven Development (SDD) with GitHub Spec Kit. It follows one real project from simple to complex, and the work is split three ways: a human or strong model writes the constitution, spec, plan, and answer key; a free model (OpenCode with opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free) runs tasks and implement; and a separate reviewer grades the result against a hidden answer key.

The guide is written while learning, so it records the confusing points too. The audience is practicing senior engineers who already use AI coding agents, with full step-by-step help for mid-level developers. Results come from real free-model runs, graded only against the reviewer's answer keys and the projects' own tests. They are not independently certified beyond that. Commands were checked against specify-cli 1.1.3.

## Guide

- [Home](https://tosin2013.github.io/invoice-exception-desk/): Should this work use SDD at all (a decision gate), the Spec Kit loop, and a router by project stage
- [L0: Start from an existing repo](https://tosin2013.github.io/invoice-exception-desk/L0-existing-repo.html): Brownfield adoption in six steps on python-slugify, comparing a run where the free model planned with the recommended split
- [L1: Setup](https://tosin2013.github.io/invoice-exception-desk/L1-setup.html): Install specify-cli, run specify init --integration opencode, use the dot-syntax commands (/speckit.tasks), and build a tiny first feature

## Example branches

- [l0-start](https://github.com/tosin2013/invoice-exception-desk/tree/l0-start): python-slugify at upstream commit 35aca63 (MIT), before Spec Kit, with a NOTICE crediting upstream
- [l0-solution](https://github.com/tosin2013/invoice-exception-desk/tree/l0-solution): One commit per L0 step: inventory, specify init, constitution, and the --json feature
- [l1-start](https://github.com/tosin2013/invoice-exception-desk/tree/l1-start): An empty starting point with a README
- [l1-solution](https://github.com/tosin2013/invoice-exception-desk/tree/l1-solution): The finished split_bill tiny feature from L1
